brand.name: Fjord Tea
brand.tagline: Loose-leaf tea, packed by hand in Bergen.
brand.voice: Calm, plain, a little dry. Short sentences. No exclamation marks.
brand.audience: Tea drinkers in Norway and Sweden who buy loose leaf, 30–60.
always: Name the origin of the leaves

published.caption: Darjeeling second flush is in. Muscatel, a bit of wood. We packed the first 200 bags this morning.
Rain in Bergen, kettle on. Assam from the Mangalam estate, if you want something that stands up to milk.
Shop's closed Monday. Orders still go out Tuesday.
Weighing out 50 g of Sencha from Shizuoka. That's it, that's the video.
